title: VibeComfy Authority Receipt V1
description: Schema for the immutable authority receipt persisted under the per-turn authority/ namespace. Records submit graph bytes, cumulative delta envelope, candidate hash, schema version, replay verification result, and response metadata hashes.

schema_version.description: V2 delta schema version at receipt time (e.g. 2.0.0).

submit_graph_hash.description: Canonical JSON hash of the submit graph.

submit_graph_bytes_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical submit graph bytes.

cumulative_delta_envelope.description: The normalized cumulative V2 delta envelope ({schema_version, ops}).

cumulative_delta_hash.description: Canonical JSON hash of the cumulative delta envelope.

candidate_hash.description: Canonical JSON hash of the persisted candidate graph.

replay.description: Replay verification result from re-applying the cumulative delta to the submit graph.

response_metadata.description: Hashes of response metadata fields for tamper detection.

candidate_matches.description: Whether the recomputed candidate hash exactly matches the persisted candidate hash.

error.description: Error label when replay fails (e.g. missing_submit_graph, candidate_hash_mismatch).

response_hash.description: Canonical JSON hash of the full response.

eligibility_hash.description: Canonical JSON hash of the eligibility payload.

outcome_hash.description: Canonical JSON hash of the outcome payload.
